title: Owner says what the Fly checklist should do differently
goal: The owner decides the checklist steps, order, checks and when it opens
acceptance: The owner's reply is recorded with its date
privacy: The owner's reply is recorded without coordinates, addresses or private flight data
validation: The owner's dated reply in the record
escalation: A failure reopens the record with a failing case before any fix

effort.basis: Reading the panel and writing one reply. Estimated 2026-11-26 from the record's scope at the harness 10.21.3 reconcile; no calibration samples exist yet (first hour estimates here). Estimate, not a measurement.
